paragraphs.text: North Pontotoc’s boys soccer team beat Kosciusko 9–3 in Ecru on Thursday, November 5, according to the final match record on MaxPreps.
Pontotoc fell 4–1 at New Albany the same night. The Warriors trailed 3–1 at halftime, and New Albany added one goal in the second half while holding Pontotoc scoreless.
The records listed with the completed matches put North Pontotoc at 2–0 and Pontotoc at 1–1.
